criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Ordering & Activation
categories.definition: Inquiries about ordering new cards, replacing existing ones, card delivery status, or activating a card.

categories.name: Card Transaction Issues
categories.definition: Queries about cards not working for payments, withdrawals, contactless, or issues with PINs or ATMs.

categories.name: Unauthorized Transactions
categories.definition: Reporting or inquiring about suspicious, unrecognized, or fraudulent transactions on an account or card.

categories.name: Refunds & Payment Reversals
categories.definition: Inquiries about the status of a refund, why a payment was reversed, or how to initiate a refund.

categories.name: Outgoing Transfers & Payments
categories.definition: Questions about sending money, transfer fees, transfer status, or issues with outgoing payments.

categories.name: Account Funding & Deposits
categories.definition: Inquiries about adding money to an account via top-ups, deposits, or receiving funds, including related fees, limits, or status.

categories.name: Currency Exchange
categories.definition: Questions about converting currencies, exchange rates, or fees for currency exchange services.

categories.name: Account & Identity Management
categories.definition: Inquiries about account access, identity verification, security settings, updating personal details, or account closure.

categories.name: General Fees & Charges
categories.definition: Questions about general account fees, unexpected charges, or understanding the overall fee structure.

categories.name: Transaction Amount Discrepancies
categories.definition: Reporting issues where the amount of money received or recorded for a transaction is incorrect or less than expected.

categories.name: Pending Transactions
categories.definition: Inquiries about why a transaction is showing as pending or how long it will take to clear.
